title.zh: Live updates: Bitcoin back under $81,000 as AI selloff worsens
title.en: Live updates: Bitcoin back under $81,000 as AI selloff worsens

current_state.zh: Bitcoin dropped below $81,000 as a hot core CPI print boosted Fed rate-hike expectations and a deepening AI selloff dragged risk assets lower, with ether down 5% and U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs losing $261 million.
